text: The lab finds the closed-loop VPT is shorter than the open-loop VPT. What is the stated reason?
choices: The closed-loop readout uses fewer neurons, lowering capacity
Prediction errors compound because they are fed back as inputs
The washout period is skipped in closed-loop mode
Closed-loop uses a higher VPT threshold than open-loop
explanation: In closed loop the ESN's own imperfect output becomes the next input, so errors feed back and compound, causing faster divergence and a shorter Valid Prediction Time. The VPT threshold (0.05) and the reservoir are identical for both modes.
